This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework changes, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, and the content focuses exclusively on regulatory amendments rather than portfolio assignments or administrative changes.

description: Land Acquisition - Parabewila and Koradoluwa, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.

description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Order made under Section 326 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance which is the Chapter 252 that should be read in Conjunction with Section 2 of the Provincial Councils and (Chapter 252) Municipal Councils Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal and regulatory matters concerning municipal governance. It references specific ordinances (Municipal Councils Ordinance Chapter 252) and acts (Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, Local Authorities (Special Provisions) Act), outlines legal procedures for budget approval, specifies consequences for non-compliance (deemed vacancy of Mayor position), and delegates powers and functions according to statutory provisions. While it mentions government officials (Governor, Mayor, Deputy Mayor), the core content focuses on legal frameworks, regulatory procedures, and statutory interpretations rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.

description: Land Acquisition - Bandarabatawala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amend to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2185/31 of 21.07.2020 - Amend to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1999/41 of 30.12.2016
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land lots (53 parcels) for public purpose (Central Expressway Project), including descriptions, extents, and claimant information. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.

description: Land Acquisition - Paranahalpe, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific land parcels are needed for a public purpose. It deals exclusively with land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While it mentions the Minister of Lands, this is only in his official capacity to authorize the land acquisition, not as the primary focus of the content.

description: Department of Local Government-Northern Province - Details of new Chairman for the Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results for a local government position (Chairman of Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and Amendment Act. It specifically deals with electoral processes and declarations at the local authority level, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes "election results and declarations" and "candidate nominations and registrations."

description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy for the Potatoes and B'onions and rescinded with effat from January 01, 2022
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies existing regulations (rescinding previous gazette notifications) and establishes new levy rates for specific commodities. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.

description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Balance Sheet as at 30th November 2021 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's balance sheet and the Auditor General's review report. This constitutes financial regulatory information and statutory reporting requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory financial reporting by a government financial institution.

description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 5th Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service, detailing examination procedures, testing methods, and syllabus requirements for public service recruitment. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and relates specifically to public sector service conditions and recruitment processes, making it a Public Service Gazette.

description: Elections Commission - Declare that K. P. L. A. Santha Kumara was elected as the member of the 05 Olagama of Kegalle Urban Council - Declare that G. A. V. Gunarathna was Selected as the member of the Kandy Manicipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kegalle Urban Council and Kandy Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including declarations of elected members to fill seats vacated due to death and failure to attend meetings, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and declarations.
